Data Engineer II

[SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - not a real vacancy]

About Quillstone Logistics
Quillstone Logistics runs warehouse and fleet operations across the Midwest. Our data team supports operations, finance and leadership reporting.

Location: Columbus, OH - Remote (US)

The Role:
You will design and maintain the pipelines that move inventory, order and fleet data into our Snowflake warehouse, and build the models analysts rely on.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL and Apache Airflow
- Design dimensional data models and normalized schemas for inventory and transactions
- Implement data quality checks, alerting and error handling for pipeline failures
- Tune slow queries and reduce warehouse costs
- Document pipelines and write runbooks for on-call engineers
- Work with operations stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements

Qualifications:
- 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering
- Advanced SQL, including window functions and CTEs
- Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift)
- Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster
- Proficiency in Python
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience

Preferred:
- dbt experience
- Experience with Kafka or other streaming systems
- AWS experience (S3, Glue, Lambda)
- Experience with Terraform
